I'm not really sure why I'm so addicted to this game. I played for over two hours and died dozens of times before I even beat the first level. Game is beyond hard. But it is constantly teasing you with the promise of more power ups. You are basically trying to collect as many life-preserving, alien-killing items you can before you are overwhelmed by the randomly spawning enemies of increasing number and difficulty. And just when you think you may have enough to escape through a porthole, the creatures unleash an unfathomable assault and you realize your existence is meaningless. This is underscored by the fact that your avatar is barely visible onscreen, surrounded by a vast, indifferent world.
The game is so much fun I don't care that I keep dying. And by the time I finally beat a level for the first time it felt like a miracle. Then I was killed almost instantly by the most basic enemies I found in the next world. This game will not hold your hand, and it will mock you when you die, and you will happily come back for more.
The graphics are rendered in beautiful pixelated minimalism. I was at first confused by the size of everything. Why are the figures so small? Because the game wants you to realize you are small. And the rest of the screen will eventually be full of the instruments of your doom. It's an incredible creative choice.
The music is also amazing. Each level essentially has one song that plays on repeat. But I didn't mind the repetition because the compositions are so dynamic and exciting. I will be seeking out the soundtrack posthaste.
This is one of the best games I've played in recent memory.

EDIT: I should have mentioned that so far I have only played the game solo. I can't comment on the multi-player, or whether the difficulty changes significantly with more players involved. For now I enjoy the isolation of playing alone, but it is brutal.

I would not suggest this game at 10$, maybe 5$.  It is, in a basic sense, an inferior version of Rogue Legacy.  The action game dimension is very simple, mostly kiting enemies and smashing your basic abilities whenever they go off cooldown.  The items aren't too balanced, which is not unusual for a game, but a stronger variety of items may have helped avoid the shoehorned gameplay.  

The enemies are simple, graphics aren't great (your character model has very little detail).  There is not much progression at all, even within a single game.  You level up and I guess it increases some base stats like health and damage (the game doesn't tell you what gained), no new abilities.  

Of course it's not an awful game, I'd say in the end I'll rate it 5-7/10. Read other reviews for their positive take on it.  But I don't find it very inspireed, compared to other rogue likes out there.

One of the best indie titles of last year, always seem to return to it and always have a great time playing! 

For lovers of Rouge like games and unlocking items through skill ( well sometimes luck too ), I would highly recommend this game.

10/10, would crashland on a planet and fight for my survival again!

One of the most under rated games on Steam. This game can be one of the most relaxing games or one of the most challenging games, depending on what you prefer. And the soundtrack is simply amazing, and one of the best I have heard. This game is well worth the price, and I would gladly pay it again.  Kudos to you, Hupoo Games.

10/10
